content: Iron Valley Fitness is open 24/7 for members. Front desk staffed hours are Monday through Friday 5:00 AM to 10:00 PM, Saturday 6:00 AM to 8:00 PM, and Sunday 7:00 AM to 6:00 PM.
On major holidays (New Year's Day, Thanksgiving, Christmas), staffed front desk hours are 8:00 AM to 2:00 PM. The gym floor remains open 24/7 for key fob members.
Iron Valley Fitness is located at 742 Iron Valley Road, Austin, TX 78701, in the Riverside district near the I-35 frontage road.
Free parking is available in our lot behind the building with 120 spaces. Street parking is also available on Iron Valley Road after 6 PM.
Basic Membership is $29/month with a $49 enrollment fee. Includes 24/7 gym access, locker rooms, and cardio and free-weight areas. Does not include group classes.
Plus Membership is $49/month with a $49 enrollment fee. Includes everything in Basic plus unlimited group fitness classes (yoga, spin, HIIT, and strength).
Premium Membership is $79/month with no enrollment fee. Includes Plus benefits plus 2 personal training sessions per month, sauna access, and guest passes (2 per month).
Annual memberships save 15% when paid upfront. Basic annual is $296, Plus annual is $500, Premium annual is $806. Ask front desk for annual signup.
Members can freeze their account for up to 3 months per year for $5/month. Medical freezes up to 6 months are available with a doctor's note at no charge.
Memberships are month-to-month with 30 days written notice to cancel. Visit the front desk or email demo@example.com to submit cancellation.
Power Yoga runs Monday and Wednesday at 6:00 AM and 6:30 PM, and Saturday at 9:00 AM. Included with Plus and Premium memberships.
Gentle Flow Yoga is Tuesday and Thursday at 7:00 AM and Friday at 5:30 PM. Suitable for all levels. Included with Plus and Premium memberships.
Spin classes run Monday through Friday at 12:00 PM and 5:45 PM, plus Saturday at 10:30 AM. Reserve bikes through the Iron Valley app up to 24 hours ahead.
HIIT Burn classes are Tuesday and Thursday at 6:00 AM and 7:00 PM, and Sunday at 11:00 AM. High intensity interval training, 45 minutes.
Barbell Strength runs Monday, Wednesday, and Friday at 7:00 AM. Focus on compound lifts with coach supervision. Included with Plus and Premium.
Full class schedule is posted at the front desk and in the Iron Valley Fitness mobile app. Group classes require Plus or Premium membership unless noted as drop-in ($15).
Personal training sessions are $65 for a single session, $300 for 5 sessions, or $550 for 10 sessions. Premium members receive 2 sessions included monthly.
Personal trainers are available Monday through Saturday 6:00 AM to 8:00 PM. Book through the front desk or app. First-time clients get a free 30-minute fitness assessment.
Our trainers specialize in weight loss, strength building, sports performance, and post-rehabilitation training. Ask about our 'New Member Kickstart' 4-week program ($199).
Cardio area includes 20 treadmills, 15 ellipticals, 10 stair climbers, 8 rowing machines, and 12 spin bikes. All equipment was upgraded in 2024.
Free weight area includes 2 squat racks, 2 deadlift platforms, dumbbells up to 120 lbs, and a full cable machine station. Olympic lifting area available during staffed hours.
Amenities include locker rooms with showers, towel service (Premium members), a sauna (Premium), and a smoothie bar open 7 AM to 7 PM daily.
New visitors can get a free 1-day pass by showing ID at the front desk. No commitment required. Perfect for trying the gym before joining.
We offer a 7-day trial for $20, which applies toward your enrollment fee if you join within 14 days. Includes full Plus-level access.
Free gym tours are available during staffed hours. Walk-ins welcome, or schedule a tour by leaving your name and phone number and our team will call you back within 24 hours.
Call us at (512) 555-0198 during staffed hours, or email demo@example.com anytime. We respond to emails within one business day.
Follow Iron Valley Fitness on Instagram @ironvalleyfitness for class updates, promotions, and member spotlights.
Basic members can bring guests for $10 per visit. Premium members get 2 free guest passes per month. All guests must sign a waiver.
Members must be 16 or older. Ages 16-17 require a parent or guardian signature. Youth fitness programs for ages 12-15 run seasonally.
Members are asked to wipe down equipment after use and re-rack weights. Cleaning stations are located throughout the gym floor.
Our most affordable option is the Basic Membership at $29/month plus a $49 enrollment fee. It includes 24/7 gym access without group classes.
Students with a valid college ID receive 10% off Plus and Premium memberships. Bring your student ID to the front desk to enroll.
All memberships are month-to-month. You can cancel anytime with 30 days written notice by visiting the front desk or emailing demo@example.com.
The member parking lot is well-lit and monitored after dark. Late-night entry requires a key fob for 24/7 members.
New visitors can pick up a free 1-day pass at the front desk with a photo ID. The pass includes access to the gym floor and cardio equipment during staffed hours.
On Sundays, staffed front desk hours are 7:00 AM to 6:00 PM. The gym floor remains open 24/7 for key fob members.
Drop-in group classes are $15 per class for non-members or Basic members. Plus and Premium memberships include unlimited classes.
If a customer wants to speak with a person immediately during staffed hours, direct them to call (512) 555-0198 or visit the front desk at 742 Iron Valley Road.
